{{Quote|Fear the unholy might of the Dark Veil Order!|A Dark Veil Order pilot, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Dathomir system}}</ref>}}
The '''Dark Veil Order''' was a matriarchal organization of religious fanatics active in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Beliefs==
{{Quote|We shall pay homage to your essence as it is consumed by the Heart of Dathomir!|A Dark Veil Order pilot, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
[[File:HeartofDathomir.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Heart of Dathomir]] nebula]]
Adepts of the Dark Veil Order worshiped the infamous [[Heart of Dathomir]], a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located near the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> They believed that a powerful knot of rage existed within the living nebula, with a power so great that only the sacrifice of sentient beings could calm the nebula's rage. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] of the Dark Veil Order controlled [[Dathomir's Vitality]], the quadrant of space containing the Heart of Dathomir, and ambushed any [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that traveled in the area. These unfortunate victims were acquired in order to be sacrificed to the Heart of Dathomir. Their reason for doing so was due to their belief that the sacrifices would fuel life into the palpitating mass of the nebula and protect the Dark Veil Order from infidels.<ref name="Sony" />

==Organization==
{{Quote|Reverend Oni`antae! Guide me so that we, together, may destroy this infidel!|A Dark Veil Order pilot, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
The Dark Veil Order was a matriarchal organization; adepts were known as [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|sisters]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> They were ruled by a [[Queen/Legends|queen]] that they served with passionate ferocity.<ref name="Sony" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Dark Veil Order pilots controlled the Dathomir's Vitality quadrant of the Dathomir system, encircling the Heart of Dathomir nebula, but they were also present in other part of the system such as the [[Emperor's Hand (quadrant)|Emperor's Hand]] quadrant.<ref name="Sony" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], these pilots were led by an individual known as Reverend [[Oni'antae Soli-nacae]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> They were organized in different units dubbed Sitaela Fighters, T'raenyan Bombers and Vin'ticula Bounty Hunters.<ref name="Sony" /> Dark Veil Order adepts usually flew [[Kihraxz assault fighter]]s, [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack crafts]] and [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Veil Order appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Dark Veil Order was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />

In the game, [[Void Wings/Legends|Void Wings]] pilots incorrectly used the same models and taunt sentences than the Dark Veil Order pilots, erroneously mentioning their cult of the Heart of Dathomir.<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
